name: 1,3-Butanediol
summary: 1,3-Butanediol is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Substituted tryptamines chemical class.

pharmacology.text: 1,3-Butanediol is likely active in its own right, prior to metabolism to BHB, but direct binding to CNS receptors has not been confirmed. The inherent activity of 1,3-Butanediol is suggested by the differential effects of its metabolite, BHB, when administered on its own in humans.

uses.text: 1,3-Butanediol is commonly used as a deodorizer and as a solvent for additives that flavor foods.

sideEffects.en: In large amounts it can cause drunkenness similar to alcohol, along with nausea, stomach upset and dizziness.
sideEffects.zh: 大量攝取時可能造成類似酒醉的狀態，並伴隨噁心、腸胃不適與頭暈。
sideEffects.zhHans: 大量摄取时可能造成类似酒醉的状态，并伴随恶心、肠胃不适与头晕。

fact.en: The liver turns 1,3-butanediol into beta-hydroxybutyrate, one of the ketone bodies the body makes when fasting. For this reason it is used in some ketone drinks.
fact.zh: 肝臟會把1,3-丁二醇轉化為β-羥基丁酸，也就是身體在禁食時產生的酮體之一。因此它被用於一些酮體飲品中。
fact.zhHans: 肝脏会把1,3-丁二醇转化为β-羟基丁酸，也就是身体在禁食时产生的酮体之一。因此它被用于一些酮体饮品中。
